Goal: pick a coupling position the three negative rounds did not test.
Read: round brief (3 losses: curved residual 0.05439, successor-barycentre shift 0.05165 moving 99.1% of items, PPMI fourth level 0.04823 with 6302 deep prefixes; baseline ~0.0679; gate 0.065), plus the measured facts that behaviour-CONTRAST correlates +0.7104 with recall while Gromov/depth weighting hurts and curvature is a gauge.
Observed/derived: Stage3 consumes only SID tuples, so any Stage-2 objective change that leaves the chosen codes identical is a no-op, and any change to item->code membership has already shown a monotone loss with deviation. Therefore the only safe shape is shape (A) with a MEASURED guard band, and the edit must be a single coordinate of an EXISTING level (no new level, no deleted code, no residual cascade) so prefix merging, off-geometry drift and argmin-pinned extra depth are all structurally excluded.
Open: whether the tie band is non-empty (band occupancy is reported; empty band = bit-identical baseline = recorded parity) and whether behaviour contrast of one level rises enough to move Stage3 per-position entropy.

const full = `IDEA: BEHTIE-SNAP
TITLE: Curvature-scaled hyperbolic behaviour-contrast snap of one existing RQ level inside a measured quantisation-error tie band.
MOTIVATION: Three rounds lost recall by moving item codes (curved residual, successor barycentre, PPMI fourth level), and the loss tracks deviation from the frozen text geometry, not prefix count. Meanwhile the programme's own 107-pair measurement says behaviour CONTRAST is the positive predictor of recall (+0.7104). The missing mechanism is one that raises behaviour contrast of the SID assignment while moving nothing off the text geometry beyond the quantiser's own error scale, and that adds no level, deletes no code and creates no residual cascade.
NOVELTY: Earlier mechanisms in this programme changed the quantiser input (curved residual chain), shifted the input toward a popularity-adjusted successor barycentre, added an argmin-pinned fourth level, ranked items radially by context entropy, or updated codebooks with successor-weighted Frechet means. This candidate freezes the trained encoder and both codebooks entirely, is applied once after Stage 2 as a deterministic 24,556-item pass, and edits exactly ONE coordinate of ONE existing level for the items inside a tie band whose width is that level's own median squared quantisation error. The curved part is a Poincare-ball geodesic comparison of popularity-adjusted transition profiles, with curvature fixed by the measured radial scale of those profiles, so the radial (peakedness/popularity) component is compressed and only behaviour DIRECTION separates codes. No new codebook, no new level, no removed code, no gradient term.
CHANGE: For each item, form the admissible set of existing level-l codes whose squared text distance to the item's encoder output is within rho_l of its current best code, then pick the code minimising a two-term dimensionless objective: normalised text distortion (weight 0.5) minus hyperbolic behaviour-contrast similarity (weight 0.5). Deeper codes are kept stale, i.e. their residual chain is not recomputed, so the edit is a single-coordinate relabelling with no cascade.
SPECIFICATION: (1) From the Stage-2 TRAIN split only, build directed transition counts C_ij = number of adjacent pairs (i then j) in training sessions; p_ij = C_ij / sum_j' C_ij'; q_j = sum_i' C_i'j / sum C; PPMI_ij = max(0, log(p_ij/q_j)); x_i = L2-normalised PPMI row truncated to its top M=20 successors (20 is the frozen Stage3 beam width, a documented default, not tuned). (2) b_i = V_64^T x_i, V_64 = top-64 right singular vectors of the PPMI matrix from a truncated SVD with fixed start vector (deterministic, no seed sweep); items with no outgoing train transitions get b_i = 0. (3) Curvature from the data: R = 95th percentile of ||b_i||, kappa = artanh(0.9)/R, c = kappa^2, so the ball is a fixed-curvature -c model in which the 95th-percentile profile sits at Poincare radius 0.9. Map b~_i = exp_0^c(b_i) = tanh(kappa||b_i||) b_i / (kappa||b_i||); code behaviour centroid mu_k = mean_{i in code k} b_i (tangent barycentre) and c~_k = exp_0^c(mu_k). (4) rho_l = median over train items of ||z_i - c_{k(i)}||^2 at level l; A_i = { k : ||z_i - c_k||^2 <= ||z_i - c_{k(i)}||^2 + rho_l }, capped to the 32 nearest codes (documented default). (5) sigma_k = mean_{i in k} d_P(b~_i, c~_k); S_i(k) = exp(-d_P(b~_i,c~_k)/sigma_k) in (0,1]. (6) J_i(k) = 0.5*||z_i - c_k||^2/rho_l - 0.5*S_i(k); k*(i) = argmin_{k in A_i} J_i(k), ties keep k(i). (7) Level l = the level with the largest measured behaviour impurity among levels l >= 2, impurity_l = 1 - mean_k mean_{i in k} cos(x_i, xbar_k) with xbar_k the normalised mean profile of code k. Level 1 is never edited, by construction of the l >= 2 restriction.
COST: zero added FLOPs inside the 72,000 Stage-2 steps (24 steps/epoch x 3000 epochs) and zero change to Stage-2 or Stage-3 wall clock except one post-hoc pass: counting train transitions O(E) over the train interaction stream, one rank-64 truncated SVD of the 24,556 x 24,556 sparse PPMI matrix (order 0.5M non-zeros) taking minutes on one CPU node, centroids and geodesics O(N*K_l*d_b) ~ 24,556 x 2,201 x 64 ~ 3.5 GFLOP taking under a second on one GPU, and the snap O(N*32*(d_b+d)) ~ 75 MFLOP. Total added wall clock is a few minutes, under 2 percent of the Stage-2 run; per-step cost at the frozen scale is exactly 0.
HYPOTHESIS: If within-prefix item groups that lead to the same popularity-adjusted successors make one SID coordinate predictable from its prefix in Stage 3, then reassigning items only among near-tied text codes raises the behaviour contrast of that coordinate, lowers the Stage-3 conditional entropy at that position, and lifts test_recall@10 above 0.065 without the deviation penalty. It is worth keeping only if the snapped level's mean intra-code behaviour contrast rises AND the measured text-distortion inflation stays at or below one median quantisation error AND the Stage-3 entropy at that position falls; if recall stays at parity the mechanism is inert and the band occupancy is the evidence.
RISKS: the tie band may be almost empty at the chosen level, so the arm is bit-identical to the baseline and the round records parity rather than a gain; the geodesic term may prefer radially extreme codes, producing many singleton deep prefixes (counted and reported); the stale residual makes the reconstruction inconsistent for moved items even though Stage 3 never reads the reconstruction; the contrast gain may be too small to survive seed noise; the measured positive contrast correlation may be cross-sectional and not causal.
BEHAVIOR SIGNAL: popularity-adjusted directed item-to-item transition profiles (positive-PMI successor sets) per item, computed from training sessions only.
BEHAVIOR COMPUTATION: from the Stage-2 training split, all user sessions in the train portion; C_ij counts adjacent (i,j) orderings; each row is turned into PPMI against the item's marginal transition share q_j; rows are L2-normalised and truncated to the top 20 successors; a rank-64 truncated SVD with a fixed start vector gives b_i. Item nodes are the 24,556 training items, so every item including validation and test items has a profile built from train edges only.
LEAKAGE BOUNDARY: the graph has edges only from train-split sessions; validation and test interactions are never read to build C, x_i, b_i, rho_l, sigma_k, the impurity score or the level choice. Text embeddings are item metadata, fixed before Stage 2. The snap is a deterministic function of (z_i, b_i, codebooks) computed after Stage 2 and before Stage 3 starts, and the frozen Stage-3 protocol, beam width and epoch budget are untouched.
HYPERBOLIC OPERATOR: Poincare-ball geodesic distance d_P(u,v) = (1/sqrt(c)) * arcosh(1 + 2c||u-v||^2 / ((1-c||u||^2)(1-c||v||^2))) with fixed negative curvature -c, c = (artanh(0.9)/q95(||b||))^2, together with the exponential map exp_0^c used to place behaviour vectors and code behaviour centroids in the ball.
HYPERBOLIC LOCATION: at quantisation time only, inside the code-selection step of one existing level; it acts on the discrete SID coordinate produced after Stage-2 training, not on Stage-2 gradients and not on Stage-3.
COUPLING PATH: (train transitions) -> PPMI rows -> rank-64 SVD -> b_i -> exp_0^c -> b~_i, and (frozen Stage 2) -> z_i and {c_k} -> rho_l and A_i, and then the two meet in one expression: A_i is filtered by Euclidean text distortion, the survivors are scored by geodesic behaviour distance to their curved centroids c~_k, and the winner is written into the SID coordinate. Switching behaviour off zeroes the curved term so A_i becomes irrelevant and k* = k(i) for every item; switching geometry off keeps A_i and b~_i but replaces d_P by the Euclidean norm on the same ball coordinates, which changes which code wins because the Poincare metric compresses radial (popularity/peakedness) differences and preserves angular (which-successor) differences.
COUPLING EQUATION: k*(i) = argmin_{k in A_i} [ 0.5 * ||z_i - c_k||^2 / rho_l  -  0.5 * exp( - d_{P,c}( b~_i , c~_k ) / sigma_k ) ] with A_i = { k : ||z_i - c_k||^2 <= ||z_i - c_{k(i)}||^2 + rho_l }, where w_behaviour(i,k) = exp(-d_{P,c}(b~_i,c~_k)/sigma_k) is the behaviour term and d_{P,c} is the curved term.
OBSERVABLES: fraction and absolute number of moved items and band occupancy per level; level-1 assignment change count (must be exactly 0); level-1..l-1 prefix counts (must be exactly unchanged) and depth-l and full-SID counts versus baseline (reported, not gated); mean intra-code behaviour contrast of the snapped level before and after; per-position conditional entropy of the Stage-3 sequences at the snapped coordinate; test_recall@10.
ABLATION BEHAVIOR OFF: BEH=0 sets w_behaviour(i,k) = 0 for all i,k, so J_i(k) is pure normalised text distortion and every item keeps its Stage-2 code; the partition and the SID table are bit-identical to the baseline and the mechanism provably does nothing. Wired as a boolean that zeroes the curved similarity before the argmin.
ABLATION GEOMETRY OFF: GEO=0 keeps the identical admissible set A_i and the identical b~_i placements but replaces d_{P,c} with the Euclidean distance ||b~_i - c~_k|| and sigma_k with the corresponding Euclidean mean, so the same information is compared without curvature; the chosen codes, and therefore the SIDs, generally differ from the both-on arm.
ABLATION BOTH ON: BEH=1 and GEO=1, the coupled argmin as written, this is the single arm that is trained and evaluated in this round.
SPEC EQUATIONS: build C from train sessions; p_ij = C_ij / sum_j C_ij; q_j = colsum(C)_j / sum(C); PPMI_ij = max(0, ln(p_ij/q_j)); x_i = normalise(top20(PPMI_i)); V = svds(PPMI, k=64, v0=fixed) right vectors; b_i = V^T x_i; kappa = artanh(0.9)/quantile95(||b||); c = kappa^2; exp_0^c(v) = tanh(kappa||v||) v/(kappa||v||) with the convention exp_0^c(0)=0; d_P as above; mu_k = mean_{i in k} b_i; c~_k = exp_0^c(mu_k); sigma_k = mean_{i in k} d_P(b~_i,c~_k); rho_l = median_i ||z_i - c_{k(i)}||^2; l = argmax_{l>=2} [1 - mean_k mean_{i in k} cos(x_i, xbar_k)]; for each i: A_i = 32 nearest codes by ||z_i - c_k||^2 whose distortion is within rho_l of the minimum; J_i(k) = 0.5*||z_i-c_k||^2/rho_l - 0.5*exp(-d_P(b~_i,c~_k)/sigma_k); k*(i) = argmin J_i(k); write SID_i[l] = k*(i), leave all other coordinates untouched; freeze the SID table and run the frozen Stage 3.
SPEC INPUTS OUTPUTS: inputs are the trained Stage-2 encoder outputs z_i for the 24,556 training items, the level-l codebook {c_k}, the train-split session stream, and the three switches BEH, GEO, and the level selector; output is a SID table in which at most one coordinate per item differs from the Stage-2 table, plus the diagnostic record (band occupancy, moved count, prefix counts, contrast, geodesics used).
SAFEGUARDS: the ball is scaled so no mapped point exceeds radius 0.9, hence 1 - c||u||^2 >= 0.19 > 0 and the geodesic denominator cannot vanish; the arcosh argument is clamped to at least 1 + 1e-8; ||b_i|| = 0 or sigma_k < 1e-6 makes S_i constant, so such items and codes never move; rho_l is clamped to at least the machine-level floor of the level's distortion to avoid a zero band; A_i is capped at 32 codes so a flat distance profile cannot move an item far; ties keep the Stage-2 code; all geodesics are computed in float64 on GPU and the argmin uses float64 reductions; the SVD start vector is fixed so the whole pass is deterministic and re-runnable; every constant is either measured on the train split (rho_l, sigma_k, kappa, l) or a documented default tied to the frozen protocol (M=20 from beam 20, 32 nearest, rank 64, radius 0.9, equal 0.5/0.5 split), so no value is chosen by trying alternatives.
END IDEA`;
await tools.progress.append_progress({ content: full });
return "recorded";
